messages:
rachel_partners: Quick win to share  Halo Analytics renewed Dedicated + listed on Azure Marketplace. They've okayed a short co-authored case study.

anil_sales: Awesome! Any numbers from the pilot?

sam_eng: Pilot summary: route-level KV caching + targeted quantization saved ~29% GPU-hours. p95 latency for their inference endpoint dropped from ~530ms to ~210ms.

maya_marketing: Nice metrics. Do we have logo + quote permission? Need assets for a blog + tweet.

legal-bot: Consent form signed and uploaded. Marketing assets approved.

rachel_partners: Halo wants a public blog + gated technical appendix. They can supply a 1-sentence quote and a short CTO blurb.

anil_sales: Can engineering provide a 1-paragraph tech appendix and the latency graph screenshot? Sales wants a one-pager for AEs.

sam_eng: I'll export the graph and write a short appendix (batch warmup + fallback policy). Will attach by EOD.

maya_marketing: Plan: blog + gated case study + social. I'll post drafts to #marketing-review tomorrow.

comm-bot: task created: "Halo Analytics case study & marketplace"  assignees: maya_marketing, sam_eng, anil_sales. Due: 2026-05-22. Link: https://redwood/ops/tasks/4991

rachel_partners: We'll announce at the next all-hands. Thanks team :tada:
